Class GUIView

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.view.GUIView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewType
public class GUIView extends javafx.application.Application implements ViewType
JavaFX application representing the Graphical User Interface (GUI) of the client. It implements ViewType to handle updates incoming from the model and render them accordingly.
